_provenance: Final configuration (2026-11-06), under the organisers' rules clarification of 2026-11-03: every setting is chosen on external data only (open-data cross-validation), never on the provided match's ground truth or video. Members: tempolens_rnd4_m0..4.pt, trained on the 10 open matches with domain randomisation (python -m tempolens.train --member k --draws 4). CV ensemble: 5 members 0.7760 (ENS5, adopted by a rule fixed before the run: >= +0.004 over 3 members' 0.7716), 0.7636 without domain randomisation. Decoder costs (switch 2, alive>dead 8, dead>alive 8, change bonus 0.5) are the argmax of that CV (experiments --model ensemble --draws 4 --members 5). Test-time adaptation, EATA and the team-evidence gate are off: in the open-data adaptation study (python -m tempolens.adaptcv --members 5; simulated, shifted and 20 real SkillCorner matches) the best adaptation gained +0.0028, under the +0.005 bar fixed before the run.
_tag_prior: 'auto' adds the self-calibrated Smart Tagging prior (tagprior.py), on open-data evidence: with synthetic tags on the cross-validated 5-member ensemble and these costs (python -m tempolens.tagstudy --draws 4 --seeds 3 --members 5) spellF1 0.7760 without the prior, 0.7841 / 0.7790 / 0.7781 / 0.7770 / 0.7754 at 0 / 10 / 20 / 35 / 50% tag team error: it helps with good tags and costs 0.0006 with random ones.
